page.overview:
Who is Aunt Betty?

Betty is a member of Marge Simpson's family. She was only mentioned by Marge in the episode "Diggs".

Betty is probably the daughter of the now deceased Antoine Bouvier and now deceased Françoise Billout, and is probably the late sister to the now deceased Pépé Bouvier, and the late sister to her other sisters, Fifi Bouvier, Coquette Bouvier, Lalique Bouvier and Monique Bouvier, and a late half-sister to the living Eunice Bouvier.

When the family was at church, Bart asked for money to donate for Sumadi, but Marge used all her money up for lighting the candles up for Aunt Betty, meaning Betty is dead.
